textCase.description: Sets the letter case of your text, whatever case it was typed in. Only how it looks changes; the text itself is kept as typed.
textCase.title: Text Case

textCaseScope.description: Which text the Text Case applies to: body paragraphs only, or all text including navigation, links and buttons. Headings have their own setting.
textCaseScope.title: Text Case Applies To

headingCase.description: Sets the letter case of headings and titles, whatever case they were typed in. Takes priority over Text Case.
headingCase.title: Heading Case

baseSize.description: The size of your body text. Headings and titles grow from it by the Type Scale.
baseSize.title: Base Font Size

typeScale.description: How much bigger each text size is than the one below it.
typeScale.title: Type Scale

logoScale.description: The height of your logo, as a multiple of the Base Font Size.
logoScale.title: Logo Scale

iconStyle.description: A small icon set before the details on an event page. Custom uses the SVG uploaded to the site's media as icons/custom.svg, in the Site Icon Color.
iconStyle.title: Site Icon Style

colorIcon.description: The color of the Site Icon. Leave empty for red (#FF4646).
colorIcon.title: Site Icon Color

showSearch.description: Allows users to search your website
showSearch.title: Enable Search

showLogin.description: Allows users to login to your website
showLogin.title: Enable Login

showHeroImage.description: Shows your hero image on the home page
showHeroImage.title: Show Hero Image

colorTint.description: Used on listing images and homepage featured events. Leave empty to use the primary text color.
colorTint.title: Duotone Tint Color

colors.title: Choose Your Own Colors
colors.description: Leave empty to keep the theme's own color.

colorBackground.description: Overrides the theme's page background color, in both light and dark mode.
colorBackground.title: Background Color

colorPrimary.description: Overrides the theme's main text color, in both light and dark mode.
colorPrimary.title: Primary Color

colorSecondary.description: Overrides the theme's secondary text color, in both light and dark mode.
colorSecondary.title: Secondary Color

colorMuted.description: Overrides the theme's muted text color, in both light and dark mode. Add two extra hex digits for transparency, e.g. #00000066.
colorMuted.title: Muted Color

colorNav.description: Overrides the theme's navigation color, in both light and dark mode.
colorNav.title: Navigation Color
